title: Enterprise Cloud LLM Deployment Selection: Serverless PAYGO vs. Provisioned PTU/GSU vs. Self-Hosted K8s (AKS/GKE) TCO Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: 100% Serverless MaaS PAYGO at High Scale (15B Tokens/Mo — Linear Token Tax & Noisy-Neighbor Jitter)
tiers.verdict: Great for <1B tokens/mo or spiky prototypes, but costs $360K/mo at 15B tokens/mo with 1.48s P99 TTFT

tiers.name: Tier 2: Premature Self-Hosted K8s for Small Workload (<500M Tokens/Mo — SRE Overhead Dominates!)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern at Low Volume: $22K/mo SRE labor + multi-AZ idle GPUs make <1B/mo self-hosting 2x more expensive than PAYGO

tiers.name: Tier 3: 100% Managed Provisioned Throughput (Azure PTU / Vertex GSU / Bedrock Provisioned Sized for Peak)
tiers.verdict: Predictable 490ms TTFT & zero GPU ops, but 100%-peak PTU sizing leaves 58% off-peak capacity unused

tiers.name: Tier 4: 3-Zone FinOps Matrix (70% Self-Hosted K8s Open-Weights + 20% P80 PTU + 10% PAYGO Burst Spillover)
tiers.verdict: Recommended: $0.68/1M tokens (-71.7% vs. Tier 1), 420ms P99 TTFT, 99.95% availability & $102K/mo TCO
